question: Who read out a declaration of independence from the Kalurghat radio station in Chittagong on 27 March 1971, on behalf of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman?
explanation: Major Ziaur Rahman broadcast a declaration of independence from Kalurghat on 27 March, on Mujib's behalf. Sources differ on the details of the first broadcasts. Mujib had been arrested on the night of 25-26 March.
